answer: One concrete defense: require each agent to lock a refundable stake that vests slowly before it can earn. Honest peers cluster like an oasis amid a dune sea, while a sybil swarm must fund every fake identity up front, bleeding collateral across a cold tundra of unproven aliases. Reputation accrues only through non-kin attestations, so a lone fake node drifts off into the nebula, unvouched and unrewarded, its bond forfeited.
